checks: A second label datum, coordinated with part number, should be a noun. The adjective, verb and adverb cannot perform that role.

activeQuestion.prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [135].
activeQuestion.promptZh: 請選出最適合填入空格 [135] 的字詞或句子。

options.whyZh: 料號與數量都是合理的標籤資訊，quantity 是所需名詞。
形容詞缺少被修飾名詞，不能表示標籤上的數量。
動詞 quantify 不能與名詞 part number 並列。
副詞不能與 part number 作此並列受詞。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 料號與數量都是合理的標籤資訊，quantity 是所需名詞。
activeQuestion.evidence: a label showing the part number and quantity

group.title: Reusable shipping trays
group.titleZh: 可重複使用的運輸托盤
group.passage:
Dear assembly partners,

Beginning with orders shipped on November 1, our modules will arrive in reusable trays. Each tray holds twelve modules and carries a label showing the part number and [135] ____.

Please inspect the trays when they arrive. If a latch is broken, photograph the damage and notify logistics before removing the modules. [136] ____

Empty trays should be returned in the carton in [137] ____ they arrived. Do not place loose screws or other small parts inside. We will arrange collection once you have accumulated at least ten trays. This return program reduces packaging waste by allowing the trays to be used [138] ____.
group.passageZh:
親愛的組裝合作夥伴：

十一月一日起出貨的訂單，模組將以可重複使用的托盤運送。每盤放十二個模組，標籤會列出料號與 [135] ____。

請在收到時檢查托盤。若扣件損壞，取出模組前先拍攝損傷並通知物流。[136] ____

空托盤應裝回送達時用的紙箱（英文關係子句的空格：[137]）。請勿把未固定的螺絲或其他小零件放進托盤。累積至少十個托盤後，我們會安排收回。此回收方案讓托盤可以 [138] ____ 使用，以減少包材浪費。
